name: Counting House
one_line: The FT's paper-and-chart restraint, banknote engraving and Saul Bass's one hot accent, for receipts that become trusted numbers.
why_for_story: The story turns a crumpled receipt into an audited number: a ledger desk with a single stamp is that moment, and nothing in the category looks like it.

references.why: the audience trusts paper and charts that look audited
money's own visual language of trust, absent from every fintech film

traits: one hot accent as the whole point of the frame
references.why: makes the stamp the single event of each scene
the 3D camera grammar for the depth beat: a receipt in a long ruled corridor
